acceptanceCriteria: pathDigest digests only the regular file it fstat-verified on the opened handle; regression test swaps in a FIFO/symlink and gets a typed refusal, not a hang or followed link.
body: Found in Codex review of the appmap bug lane (2026-10-20). internal/sessiontest/identity.go pathDigest Lstat-checks a path then Opens it by name; a swap between the two can follow a symlink or block on a FIFO. Same class as V1-0971 (appmap LoadMap). Expected: open with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK and fstat the handle, as the V1-0971 fix does.
title: sessiontest pathDigest checks with Lstat and then opens by path (TOCTOU swap to symlink/FIFO)
